item.title: Clanwilliam man sentenced to 10 years for methamphetamine trafficking
item.description: A 40-year-old resident of Clanwilliam, near Citrusdal, Shaun Titus has received a 10-year prison sentence for dealing in methamphetamine, Cape {town} Etc reports. The sentence was handed down in the Clanwilliam Magistrates Court, where Titus was found guilty under the provisions of the Drugs and Drug Trafficking Act 140/1992. item.title: Knysna on the brink: Dams hit critical low
item.description: Knysna is confronting a deepening water crisis as dam levels continue to fall, with residents and businesses facing the real threat of dry taps in the coming days.
